_comment: Labelled corpus for ROADMAP/FOCUS #1's Spinitron<->tracklist matcher.
Each case is [spin_artist, spin_song, track_artist, track_title, why].
A 'positive' is the SAME record credited two ways (a DJ typing it into
Spinitron vs whatever CDDB/MusicBrainz put on the disc) and MUST match.
A 'negative' is two different records that look similar and MUST NOT.
An 'accepted_false_positive' is a pair no string similarity can separate
(0.92+ apart by one letter, indistinguishable from a DJ's typo) which we
deliberately let through: a wrong match only re-orders the rip queue,
while tightening the threshold enough to exclude it would throw away the
real misspelling drift the feature exists to absorb. Recorded, not hidden.
Read by tests/test_spin_match_corpus.py (pins DEFAULT_THRESHOLD) and by
scripts/spin-match-eval.py (sweeps thresholds over it). One source: add a
case here, both see it. Hand-built from real credit-style drift, NOT
observed spins - a real rip's own spins are still the last word.
